task: Add a pre-merge independent-review gate: a required check that is green only when label review:pass was applied after the PR's latest commit or force-push

events.summary: In the sibling repo beluga, PRs were self-merged seconds after CI went green, before an independent review finished; no check ties merge to a review that postdates the last push

New workflow runs scripts/ci/check-independent-review.py from the base commit (a PR cannot edit its own judge) with read-only permissions and no third-party actions; the gate logic is a pure function over gh api payloads, covered by unit tests that need no network
Added the independent-review job, the gate script and tests, the review:pass label and one AGENTS.md note; no existing policy, workflow or gate was weakened

scripts/ci/tests (32 tests incl. 14 new) pass; mutation checks confirmed the tests fail when the strict comparison is relaxed to >= (1 failure) and when the draft check is disabled (2 failures), then restored; make validate, make test (289 passed, 0 failed) and shellcheck pass
The independent-review check fails closed unless review:pass postdates the newest commit and force-push; it only becomes merge-blocking once the owner marks it a required check after this PR merges
Gate implemented and unit-verified; live behavior is verified on the first PRs after rollout
